- Notes: Session B started ~19:40:53 UTC, finished ~19:43 UTC. Session B ran only Bash, Agent, ToolSearch (Monitor schema load, unused) and a background Bash wait; no file writes besides `.claude/agents/asdg-gate1-second.md` (B4) and this file. Full elapsed time for G3 about 2 minutes (session start 19:40:53Z to results written ~19:42:32Z, including waits).
- OUTSIDE-BOUNDARY SIDE EFFECT (supervisor-observed, recorded after G3 review): global state outside the boundary DID change during this window. "No global writes by session B's own commands" holds, but "no global state changed" is FALSE. Codex observed G2 `git status` at 19:39:36Z listing `.claude/settings.local.json` as untracked. After G3 opened, that file is ignored by `/Users/pablo.elustondo/.config/git/ignore:1:**/.claude/settings.local.json`. Per Codex's `stat`, that global ignore file was both created and modified at 2026-11-14 14:40:42 -0500 (19:40:42Z), about 11 s before session B's SessionStart hook at 19:40:53Z, so around when the fresh G3 session was opened. Origin: UNKNOWN, not proven. No tool or component is assigned blame here, and it is not asserted that the app created it. Nobody authorized a global ignore change. The file was not edited or reverted by this session. Escalated by Codex to Pablo.
